explication: FlowPilot is a Chrome side-panel extension for running account registration, verification, OAuth authorization, and account-delivery workflows for OpenAI, Kiro, and Grok. Users choose a flow and source, configure email and other services, then run steps manually or use Auto; the extension tracks retries and account-run records. The graph preserves the separate product flows and shared email, phone, delivery, and account-management capabilities. Several subsystem links reflect README-described behavior; unsampled implementation details are not inferred.
